expectation: Nuclear stain in vessel-lining endothelium and in naive/quiescent T cells. In gut: a scattered subset of nuclei in lymphoid aggregates and T-cell zones, and thin rings along vessels in submucosa and lamina propria. Most cells negative.
notes: KLF2 shows up as haze that follows tissue texture and density, and the slide background glows in gradients and stripes. No distinct nuclear subset appears in the fields or around the brightest cell. In the T-cell field, every cell is lit about alike.
observed: A: yellow haze over tissue and background, with stripes and gradients and scattered debris dots. Lymphoid nodules are faint. B/C: diffuse grainy haze in stroma, epithelium dimmer, no discrete nuclei. D: blotchy haze, no cells. E: KLF2 is uniform grain across the CD3E-dense field, with green speckle off cells.
why: No specific nuclear subset at any scale: the signal is background haze and grain that follows tissue texture, not a cell type.
